name: @polleoai/gryphon-protect
description: Runtime protection for Gryphon: stops AI assistants from changing protected files, running risky commands, or weakening their own security settings. Works inside Obsidian or in your own Node host.
author: POLLEO.AI

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('dist/index.js')){console.error('prepack: dist/index.js missing - run npm run prebuild at the repo root first');process.exit(1)}fs.copyFileSync('../../LICENSE','LICENSE')"
